bindings.evidence: when the compare branch gains a new commit, all decisions become stale and a new review is required
bindings.explanation: save-new-file advances the compare branch head to a newly created commit but leaves pr-1.compareCommit at c-5. eligibility therefore still counts the old non-author Approve and keeps the PR mergeable, even though a new commit on the compare branch must make that approval stale and require a fresh review.

bindings.evidence: Each reviewer has only one effective decision on a given current compare commit; a new decision replaces the reviewer's effective decision while preserving history.
bindings.explanation: The fixture has Bob's non-author Approve on PR-1 at commit c-5. When Bob submits a Comment on the same current compare commit, submit-review appends a second review instead of replacing Bob's effective decision. eligibility still treats the old Approve as satisfying Require 1 approval, so the protected branch remains mergeable.

Repository identity is owner/name, so duplicate validation must be scoped to the selected owner.
